V18.5: This has been mentioned before in requirement v5.13. 
V18.6: I would put this as a requirement also for L1 

I can think of the following additional requirements:
-   Verify that the message payload is signed to ensure reliable transport between client and service. (L2+ and L3). For instance based on WS-Security.
-   Verify that alternative and less secure access paths do not exist (L2 and L3).
